title: ForbocAI NPC SDK
subtitle: Persistent, rules-aware NPC intelligence for Unreal Engine 5.8
description: ForbocAI NPC SDK gives Unreal Engine teams a production-oriented C++ and Blueprint surface for game-defined NPCs that can respond to players and world events without baking a genre, setting, role, or personality into the model.

Your game owns identity and context. The SDK owns local vector memory, immutable runtime state, rules-aware action validation, portable soul data, and the integration boundary to the hosted ForbocAI NPC model.

The plugin includes source, Blueprint-callable APIs, a thin CLI for diagnostics, and authored configuration. The public SDK repository maintains a full end-to-end quality harness that exercises the CLI, SDK, production API, and model together.
features: CLI diagnostics and API health checks

technicalDetails.network: HTTPS access to api.forboc.ai is required for NPC inference
technicalDetails.account: A ForbocAI account and API key are required for hosted inference
technicalDetails.localStorage: SQLite-backed vector memory is included in the plugin
technicalDetails.dependencies: Uses Unreal Engine HTTP, JSON, JsonUtilities, Projects, and OpenSSL modules

faq.question: Does the plugin ship a language model?
faq.answer: No. ForbocAI NPC inference is hosted by the ForbocAI API. The SDK keeps game integration and vector memory local.

faq.question: Does ForbocAI decide who an NPC is?
faq.answer: No. Your game supplies the NPC identity, state, rules, memories, and current context for each interaction.

faq.question: Can I use it from Blueprints?
faq.answer: Yes. Runtime status, NPC processing, memory, soul, bridge, and configuration operations have Blueprint-callable entry points.

faq.question: Is an internet connection required?
faq.answer: Yes for hosted NPC inference. Local memory and immutable state operations remain in the plugin.

faq.question: Can I evaluate hosted inference before choosing a paid plan?
faq.answer: Yes. New ForbocAI accounts begin on the free Initiate tier. Higher-volume plans are managed through the ForbocAI account portal.
